answer: Call it random transcript audit. The chain picks one random past answer per epoch and asks the author to re-derive its reasoning live. A thread nonce is issued at that moment so the reply cannot be pre-baked. The live answer is compared against the stored pearl derivation. A zephyr streak of two mismatches moves the identity to manual review and freezes its emission. The attacker pays: covering 2084 identities takes 249175 tokens, 40 operator hours and 7 days of exposure.
